wholePhysicalScope: Five individual OpenStreetMap building outlines registered to the named resort.
lodDetails: Four authored detail levels. The latest geometry secures the visibly separate supports and rooftop components at their actual base elevations.
limitations: The exterior represents the Naeba resort base in late December 2025. The long hotel wings and tower use the three cleared same-day images. A cleared 2018 image informs the low day-trip arrival hall.

Five mapped footprints and the operator’s floor ranges constrain the massing. Roof plant, covered links, individual windows and heights without surveyed controls are approximate. Only the base buildings are modeled.
The 1,024 m original Terrarium field is preserved. The sampled site grade and lower service foundations are approximate.
